statement: Zhou Mingrui, a modern Chinese Earthling, has transmigrated into the body of Klein Moretti in the Loen Kingdom.

sources.quote: 'C-could I have transmigrated?'

statement: This world's moon glows crimson, clearly different from Earth's moon.

sources.quote: a crimson moon hung high above the backdrop of a 'black velvet curtain'

statement: Klein Moretti is a recent graduate of the Department of History at Khoy University.

sources.quote: a recent graduate from the Department of History at Khoy University

statement: Klein's father was an Imperial Army sergeant who died in a colonial conflict on the Southern Continent.

sources.quote: a sergeant of the Imperial Army who had sacrificed himself during a colonial conflict with the Southern Continent

statement: Klein's mother was a devotee of the Evernight Goddess; she died the year Klein passed his university entrance exams.

sources.quote: His mother was a devotee of the Evernight Goddess.

statement: Klein has an elder brother (Benson) and a younger sister (Melissa); the family lives together in a two-bedroom apartment.

sources.quote: He also had an elder brother and a younger sister. They stayed in a two bedroom apartment together.

statement: As a history graduate, Klein knows Ancient Feysac (deemed the origin of all Northern Continent languages) and the Hermes language.

sources.quote: Klein grasped knowledge of the ancient Feysac language... as well as the Hermes language

statement: The notebook on Klein's desk bears a message in the Hermes language: 'Everyone will die, including me.'

sources.quote: "Everyone will die, including me."

statement: A brass revolver sits on Klein's desk; Zhou is puzzled how the poor family could afford one.

sources.quote: With Klein's family situation, how can they have the money or means to buy a revolver?

statement: There is a bloody handprint by the desk, and Zhou's hands and temple are covered in blood.

sources.quote: a red handprint to the side of the table... his palm and fingers were covered in blood

statement: Zhou's temple bears a grotesque, self-closing gunshot wound; the flesh visibly regenerates, which he attributes to 'the restorative effects of transmigration.'

sources.quote: the wound might take thirty to forty minutes... before it would only leave a light scar

statement: Klein apparently died from a self-inflicted revolver shot to the temple (provisionally treated as suicide).

sources.quote: Well, I'll consider it as suicide for now.

statement: The night before his transmigration, Zhou performed a 'luck enhancement ritual' from 'Quintessential Divination and Arcane Arts of the Qin and Han Dynasty'; at the time it appeared to have no effect.

sources.quote: nothing happened back then

statement: Zhou hypothesizes the luck enhancement ritual actually caused his transmigration, and plans to repeat it in this world hoping to return home.

sources.quote: There is a distinct possibility that it's due to that luck enhancement ritual...

statement: The family's apartment uses a coin-operated gas meter feeding a wall-mounted gas lamp — a relative luxury Benson persuaded the landlord to install.

sources.quote: he reasoned with the landlord to 'raise the apartment's standards by installing gas pipes'

statement: The basic Loen currency is the copper penny (one penny buying power about three to four yuan of Zhou's original world); other denominations include fivepence, halfpence and quarterpence.

sources.quote: One penny's purchasing power was roughly three to four yuan before his transmigration.

statement: The copper penny has been minted and circulated since King George III ascended the Loen throne.

sources.quote: which was only minted and circulated after King George III ascended to the throne

statement: The family's landlord is Mr. Franky, a short, thrifty man who polices water use closely because rent includes water.

sources.quote: he suddenly recalled his landlord, Mr. Franky

statement: The Northern Continent has seven orthodox gods: the Eternal Blazing Sun, the Lord of Storms, the God of Knowledge and Wisdom, the Evernight Goddess, Earth Mother, the God of Combat, and the God of Steam and Machinery.

sources.quote: the Northern Continent had seven orthodox gods

statement: The seven-day week derives from religion (the seven orthodox gods), while the twelve-month year derives from astronomical observation.

sources.quote: The splitting of months was a result of astronomical observations... as for the splitting of days, it was a result of religion.

statement: Zhou suspects he may be in a parallel world, noting the unusual split of time (months from astronomy, days from religion).

sources.quote: It made Zhou Mingrui suspect whether he was in a parallel world.

statement: Klein has a History department interview at Tingen University in two days, backed by recommendation letters for Tingen and Backlund universities.

sources.quote: He needs to participate in the Tingen University's History department interview two days later

statement: Melissa aspires to be a steam mechanic and is a student in the Steam and Machinery department of Tingen Technical School.

sources.quote: Her ambition was to be a steam mechanic.

statement: Fifteen-year-old Melissa passed her Tingen Technical School entrance exams in July last year.

sources.quote: fifteen-year-old Melissa passed her entrance examinations

statement: Benson is a clerk at an import-export company whose business has slumped due to Southern Continent troubles; he works overtime to keep the family afloat.

sources.quote: Benson's company was affected by the situation in the Southern Continent

statement: The siblings keep a silver vine-leaf pocket watch bearing their father's photo; it malfunctions, and the mechanically gifted Melissa fixes it.

sources.quote: It was a picture of the siblings' father. It was the most valuable item the Imperial Army sergeant left behind

statement: The Loen 'pound' (a weight unit) is roughly half a kilogram.

sources.quote: it was close to half a kilogram of what he was accustomed to

statement: The bullet passing through the head left Klein's memories fragmented, with notable gaps around the revolver's origin and the circumstances of his death.

sources.quote: Klein's memories were like shattered glass... there were many spots which were clearly missing
